patterns.note: Content is consistently centered and width-constrained within full-bleed sections that use distinct background colors for visual separation.

A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for primary messages and smaller, lighter sans-serif text for body content, often with uppercase labels for navigation and sub-sections.

High contrast color scheme featuring a deep, dark teal/blue for prominent sections, paired with white text, and white backgrounds for other sections, paired with dark grey text. A bright yellow serves as a primary accent for calls-to-action and branding.
The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport, shrinking slightly in height, and gaining a solid dark background color.
Detailed, realistic 'dashboard' style UI screenshots are prominently featured as hero and explanatory visuals, illustrating product functionality directly within the page layout.

technique_notes: Full-width sections utilize contrasting background colors to delineate content blocks, with all internal content aligned to a central, fixed-width container.
Product functionality is showcased through high-fidelity, static screenshots of the application's user interface, integrated as hero imagery and within feature explanations.

The main navigation bar is designed to transition from an initial state to a sticky, more compact version with a solid background color once the user scrolls past the hero section, ensuring continuous access to navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body size) with clear size progression for subheadings and smaller, legible body text; some elements use uppercase styling.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (small corner radius on buttons, cards, and image containers).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (comfortable padding around sections and elements, with a slightly more airy feel in the hero section).

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its heavy reliance on highly detailed, realistic 'dashboard' UI screenshots as the primary visual storytelling element, effectively demonstrating product value and functionality without needing interactive demos.
